_about: HF131 - THE PLAY-TABLE INJECTION ROW (playTableInjectionDerivation.js). A mod that injects its own packet type early into the CLIENTBOUND play template shifts every later vanilla id by one, so a pal decoding with the published table reads every play frame under the wrong name. The culprit is a bytecode SHAPE, never a mod list: a class whose constant pool carries a method reference to the version's protocol-builder add-packet method, whose mixin targets the version's GameProtocols class, and whose injector annotation names the clientbound builder lambda. One row per game version and mapping namespace; the names are the version's own (intermediary for Fabric jars, mojmap for NeoForge 1.20.5+ jars). A version without a row derives no_version_data and names no mod.

intermediary.source: FabricMC intermediary 1.21.1 over mojmap 1.21.1 (GameProtocols / ProtocolInfoBuilder / PacketType / addPacket / lambda$static$1); verified against the javap of the levelz 2.0.12 PlayStateFactoriesMixin bytes (test/fixtures/hf131-levelz-2.0.12.trimmed.jar)
